reference.title: Scenario 2: Two-level nested bullet list
reference.shortdesc: Consider a .md file about deployment options that groups related features into categories.

section.p: Consider a .md file about deployment options that groups related features into categories.

entry.codeblock: # Deployment Options - Cloud Deployment - Multi-tenant environment - Automatic updates - Managed infrastructure - On-Premises Deployment - Local data storage - Custom security policies - Internal network access

Deployment Options
  • Cloud Deployment
    • Multi-tenant environment
    • Automatic updates
    • Managed infrastructure
  • On-Premises Deployment
    • Local data storage
    • Custom security policies
    • Internal network access

section.p: Result: The converter preserves the hierarchical relationship between the parent bullet items and their nested bullet items. The first-level list becomes a DITA <ul>, and each nested list becomes a child <ul> contained within the corresponding list item.
